## Episode Thesis

Peter Lindell, Brunswick Group's head of Sweden, is cautiously positive about the Nordic IPO market for late 2026 and especially 2027. He points to long-held PE portfolios that need exits and to Stockholm gaining ground as an alternative to London and Amsterdam, while valuation gaps and geopolitical volatility still hold listings back. Private M&A in Europe is described as running at full speed, driven by US buyers, with energy, infrastructure and defence active in Sweden. Examples include the German state's planned sale of Uniper and its Swedish power assets. The episode also covers election risk to Sweden's capital market, and Lindell expects the more extreme proposals to be dropped in post-election negotiations.
